propositions: ADR 0101 must be created to amend ADR 0043 and document the rename of the `operator` token and the retained `[operator-attested]` alias without modifying ADR 0043 itself
The `operator` token mis-signalled human identity when agents can equally attest via Gerrit votes, requiring clarification that agents are acceptable actors
`[non-codebase]` is the missing complement to the existing `[codebase]` token used at three documented sites and resists attestation laundering by construction
`attested` alone was rejected because SOURCE_ATTESTED means pinned to immutable in-repo SHA, creating semantic conflict despite no functional collision
`[operator-attested]` remains accepted and deliberately undocumented because 827 of 4,285 live tickets carry it in immutable event records
ADR index, numbering checks, and documentation index must be regenerated and verified after creating ADR 0101
